Reached only when INTRTI(1:INTRTL) holds a character outside digits, '.', '-', '+' and space. INTRT is a NUM field on the BNK1CA map, which a 3270 cannot key letters or other characters into (owner decision on #5116, 2026-10-15: rate-letters dropped), so every non-numeric rate that reaches the tally is made of the tallied characters and the tally equals INTRTL.

BNK1CAC reference-modifies INTRTI(1:INTRTL) past its 7 bytes once more than two characters follow the point (lines 611, 637): IBM without SSRANGE reads the bytes after the field (layout luck), libcob refuses. Owner ruling 2026-10-29: undefined by IBM (X8, bounds_refused rate-three-places).

OVERDRI NOT NUMERIC after BIF DEEDIT: the digit tally at 701 rejects any overdraft field holding a non-digit (OVERDRL > tally), and DEEDIT of an all-digit field leaves it numeric.

CREACC sets a fail code on every 'N' return, and every code it sets has its own WHEN, so OTHER is never reached.
WHEN '2': CREACC sets only fail codes '1', '3', '5', '7', '8', '9' and 'A' (318-1224); it never sets '2'.
SUBPGM-FAIL-CODE '3' is set only by CREACC's ENQ-NAMED-COUNTER when RESP is not NORMAL (CREACC 397), which is never true: the ENQ has no NOSUSPEND and a 16-byte name of LENGTH(16).
WHEN '4': CREACC sets only fail codes '1', '3', '5', '7', '8', '9' and 'A' (318-1224); it never sets '4'.
SUBPGM-FAIL-CODE '5' is set only by CREACC's DEQ-NAMED-COUNTER when RESP is not NORMAL (CREACC 419), which is never true: the DEQ follows the task's own ENQ of the same 16-byte name.
WHEN '6': CREACC sets only fail codes '1', '3', '5', '7', '8', '9' and 'A' (318-1224); it never sets '6'.
WHEN 'A' (CREACC account type not one of ISA, MORTGAGE, SAVING, CURRENT, LOAN): BNK1CAC accepts only those types in ED010 (474) and normalises them, so CREACC's type check always passes.
